top_signals.title: DP World plots US port comeback with Corpus Christi container terminal
top_signals.summary:
DP World and the Port of Corpus Christi have signed a lease option agreement for a container terminal that could eventually handle about 1 million TEUs annually.

The post DP World plots US port comeback with Corpus Christi container terminal  appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
